summary: AXIA Energia S.A. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a distance voting ballot for an Extraordinary General Meeting (EGM) scheduled for August 28, 2026. The filing provides procedural instructions for shareholders to exercise remote voting rights, including submission deadlines and requirements. It also notes a governance restriction under the company’s bylaws capping voting rights at 10% of voting capital per shareholder or group. No special-situation event (acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, etc.) is disclosed. This is a routine EGM notice/management information circular, not a special situation.
